request: An enclosure for a 90 x 45 mm perfboard with a mounting hole in each corner. A Raspberry Pi Pico 2 lies along the board with its micro-USB port exposed through one short end, and three 3.5 mm jacks sit in a row along one long edge of the board, exposed through that long side of the enclosure. Cables must plug in with the lid on. The enclosure is a base and a removable lid, printed on an FDM printer. Requirements: The design shall place the Pico 2 and three 3.5 mm jacks on the 90 x 45 mm board, from the parts catalogue, with the Pico's USB port facing one short (45 mm) end and all three jacks facing the same long (90 mm) side, at least 11 mm apart, without the parts colliding or covering the corner holes, and shall declare that layout. The 90 x 45 x 1.6 mm board shall fit inside the closed enclosure with at least 0.5 mm clearance to every printed surface, apart from where it rests on its supports. The board shall rest on exactly four standoffs, one under each corner hole, each with a pilot hole for a screw through the board. With the lid closed, no part of the enclosure shall come within 12 mm above the board's top surface or 4 mm below its underside, except the standoffs under the holes, and the Pico and the jacks shall lie inside the enclosure. With the lid closed, a micro-USB cable shall plug fully into the Pico through one opening in its end wall without touching the enclosure, and that opening shall be no more than 1.5 mm bigger than the plug on any side. With the lid closed, three 3.5 mm plugs shall plug fully into the three jacks at the same time through three openings in the long side wall without touching the enclosure or each other, and each opening shall be no more than 1.5 mm bigger than the plug on any side. The enclosure shall be a base and a separate removable lid that locates on the base with a sliding fit and is held closed. The closed enclosure shall have no openings other than the USB opening, the three jack openings and screw holes, and its walls, floor and lid shall be 2 to 4 mm thick. The base and the lid shall each be one manifold body that prints on an FDM printer without supports. The closed enclosure shall be no larger than 110 x 65 x 35 mm, longest along the board's 90 mm side, and shall stand flat on a desk without tipping. With the lid off, the populated board shall drop straight down onto its standoffs and every board screw shall be reachable with a screwdriver. The design shall be delivered as a base STL, a lid STL, the OpenSCAD source, the declared board layout and the agent's own clearance report, and that report shall agree with an independent measurement.
